declaration.aperture_lux: uniform upper sky,10000lx exterior; black walls, unglazed opening, black lower hemisphere
declaration.coefficient_residual_policy: Every full-direct RGB bin nonnegative; black-glass and uniform residuals exactly zero; no clamping
declaration.encoding_policy: Six finite f64 values per ray: origin XYZ then direction XYZ; ASCII lowercase scientific notation with 17 digits after the decimal point (18 significant digits), exponent without a plus sign or redundant leading zeros; one space between values, one LF after each ray, no BOM. Signed zero is preserved.
declaration.measurement_scope: Streaming telemetry samples whole-Job plus runner working sets and local execution directory file sizes, including scan/query time plus20ms sleep; no hard20ms cadence. Compilation uses historical child-lifetime peak and runner-plus-child samples. These scopes remain distinct.
declaration.normalization: pi*coefficient mean/100 once; no second division by primary count
declaration.rule: Sensor-major, primary index i=0..N-1 at each sensor: r=sqrt((i+0.5)/N), phi=2*pi*radical_inverse_base2(i), direction=(r*cos(phi),r*sin(phi),sqrt(1-r*r)); no rotation, scramble or culling. World-up sensors only; origin=sensor.position+(0,0,0.0001)m. One uninterrupted stream; no native process restart between sensors.
declaration.scope: Isolated actual Rust producer/supervisor bridge; no production annual method or accuracy-profile acceptance

build_identity.scope: Uncommitted isolated generator/bridge modules plus the committed isolated supervisor; exact source snapshots are pinned in declaration.source_sha256.
